text: The Bank of Nova Scotia (which operates and trades under the brand name Scotiabank -- they are the same legal entity, not parent and subsidiary) is a publicly listed bank (TSX/NYSE) with no state shareholder identified; ownership sits with public institutional and retail investors.

source.name: Scotiabank Annual Report 2025
source.quote: The common shares of the Bank are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) and the New York Stock Exchange.
